question:
You will be shown several images captured during a robotic manipulation task.
Each image comes with a description of the camera position from which it was taken.
Please use this information to help answer the following question.


Image 1 (fix_center): From the center position, a fixed camera records this view of the robotic activity.


Image 2 (ego_left): This camera angle provides the robot's left arm perspective of the task.


Image 3 (ego_right): The right wrist camera captures this egocentric view of the robotic operation.


These images showcase various viewpoints of an identical robotic manipulation sequence.
One image represents a different time point compared to the synchronized others.
Examine visual indicators such as shadow positions, object arrangements, and robotic arm configurations.
Which image number exhibits temporal displacement?
